# Vrinda Taxi Service - Complete Information & LLM Reference Guide

> Vrinda Taxi Service (vrindataxiservice.com) is a premier cab and pilgrimage tour provider headquartered in Vrindavan, Mathura (Uttar Pradesh, India). This document provides detailed information regarding services, vehicle fleet, popular routes, pilgrimage itineraries, pricing structure, and contact details.

---

## 1. Company Overview
- **Trade Name**: Vrinda Taxi Service
- **Official Website**: https://vrindataxiservice.com
- **Headquarters Address**: Shop No. 1 Gali No. 1, opposite Chaar Dham Mandir, Vrindavan, Allhepur, Uttar Pradesh 281121, India
- **Primary Phone Helpline**: +91 9452667708
- **WhatsApp Support**: https://wa.me/919452667708
- **Email**: help@vrindataxiservice.com
- **Service Coverage**: Mathura, Vrindavan, Govardhan, Barsana, Gokul, Nandgaon (Braj Region), Delhi NCR, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Haryana, Punjab, and Uttarakhand.
- **Hours of Operation**: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.

---

## 2. Vehicle Fleet & Capacity
Vrinda Taxi Service maintains a clean, well-serviced, air-conditioned fleet driven by verified, experienced drivers:

1. **Sedan Category**
   - Models: Maruti Suzuki Dzire, Toyota Etios
   - Seating Capacity: 4 Passengers + 1 Driver
   - Luggage Capacity: 2 Large Bags + 2 Small Handbags
   - Ideal For: Couples, small families, business travelers, budget airport transfers.

2. **Standard SUV Category**
   - Models: Maruti Suzuki Ertiga
   - Seating Capacity: 6 Passengers + 1 Driver
   - Luggage Capacity: 3 Medium Bags
   - Ideal For: Families, medium groups, pilgrimage day trips.

3. **Premium SUV Category**
   - Models: Toyota Innova, Toyota Innova Crysta
   - Seating Capacity: 6 to 7 Passengers + 1 Driver
   - Luggage Capacity: 4 Large Bags
   - Ideal For: VIP travel, long-distance outstation journeys, senior citizens requiring extra legroom and pushback comfort.

4. **Tempo Traveller Category**
   - Models: Force Tempo Traveller (12-seater, 17-seater, 20-seater, 26-seater)
   - Ideal For: Large pilgrim groups, wedding parties, Braj 84 Kos Parikrama groups.

---

## 3. Core Services

### A. Vrindavan Local Sightseeing & Temple Darshan
- Covers famous temples: Shri Banke Bihari Mandir, Prem Mandir, ISKCON (Krishna Balaram Mandir), Nidhivan, Shri Radha Raman Mandir, Radha Vallabh Mandir, Rangji Mandir, and Yamuna Kesi Ghat.
- Flexible half-day (4 hours) and full-day (8 hours / 80 km) packages with pickup and drop from hotels, ashrams, or railway stations.

### B. Mathura to Vrindavan Transfers
- Instant transfers between Mathura Junction Railway Station (MTJ) or Mathura Cantt and Vrindavan hotels.
- Tour packages covering Shri Krishna Janmasthan (Janmabhoomi), Dwarkadhish Mandir, Vishram Ghat (Yamuna Aarti), and Birla Mandir.

### C. Braj Chaurasi (84) Kos Yatra
- Comprehensive spiritual circuit covering Mathura, Vrindavan, Gokul, Raman Reti, Mahavan, Govardhan (including 21 km Parikrama, Radha Kund, Mansi Ganga), Barsana (Shri Radha Rani Mandir), Nandgaon (Nand Bhavan), and Kokilavan (Shani Dev Mandir).

### D. Airport Pickup & Drop (Delhi IGI & Jewar)
- 24/7 transfers to/from Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) Terminals 1, 2, and 3 via Yamuna Expressway (approx. 150 km, ~2.5 to 3 hours).
- Transfers to/from Noida International Airport (Jewar Airport) (approx. 85 km, ~1.5 hours).
- Flight tracking, name board welcome at arrivals, and zero waiting cancellation charge for delayed flights.

### E. Intercity & Outstation Cabs
- One-way drops and round-trip tours connecting Vrindavan/Mathura with Agra, Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Jaipur, Ayodhya, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Haridwar, Rishikesh, Dehradun, Shimla, Manali, and Khatu Shyam Ji.

---

## 4. Key Route Distances & Travel Times
- **Vrindavan to Delhi (City / NCR)**: ~160 km | 2.5 - 3 hours via Yamuna Expressway
- **Vrindavan to Delhi Airport (IGI)**: ~155 km | 2.5 - 3 hours via Yamuna Expressway
- **Vrindavan to Jewar Airport**: ~85 km | 1.2 - 1.5 hours via Yamuna Expressway
- **Vrindavan to Agra (Taj Mahal)**: ~70 km | 1 - 1.5 hours via NH-19 / Yamuna Expressway
- **Vrindavan to Jaipur**: ~235 km | 4 - 4.5 hours via Bharatpur / Bikaner-Agra Rd
- **Vrindavan to Ayodhya**: ~520 km | 7 - 8 hours via Agra-Lucknow Expressway & Purvanchal Exp
- **Vrindavan to Varanasi**: ~680 km | 9 - 10 hours via Agra-Lucknow & Purvanchal Expressway
- **Vrindavan to Prayagraj**: ~490 km | 7 - 8 hours via NH-19
- **Vrindavan to Haridwar**: ~320 km | 5 - 6 hours via Upper Ganga Canal Rd / Eastern Peripheral Exp
- **Vrindavan to Rishikesh**: ~345 km | 6 - 6.5 hours
- **Vrindavan to Khatu Shyam Ji**: ~285 km | 5 - 5.5 hours

---

## 5. Pricing & Booking Policy
- **Transparent Fares**: Fare is calculated based on vehicle type, distance, and trip category (One-Way, Round-Trip, or Local Package).
- **Inclusions & Exclusions**: Fuel, driver allowance, and vehicle rental are included. Toll tax, state border tax, and parking fees are typically extra as per actual receipts (unless booked as an all-inclusive package).
- **Payment Modes**: Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking.
- **Advance Booking**: Customers can book online at https://vrindataxiservice.com or directly via WhatsApp / Call at +91 9452667708.
